results.title: International consortium establishes first consensus-based framework and standardized taxonomy for vocal biomarkers
results.description: 24 researchers published the first standardized vocal biomarker framework to unify voice health research. It separates basic measures from validated clinical indicators.

results.title: Richard Buxton says AI cannot replace human experience in fund management
results.description: AI reads 10 years of annual reports in seconds, but managers need in-person meetings to assess executive trust. Human judgment remains essential for evaluating leaders.
